evidence.quote: In the near term, elevated unemployment and stable inflation expectations should keep inflation subdued, and indeed, inflation could move lower from here.
my best guess at this point is that we will continue to see modest economic growth next year--sufficient to bring down the unemployment rate, but at a pace slower than we would like.
However, as the recovery strengthens, the time will come when it is appropriate to begin withdrawing the unprecedented monetary stimulus that is helping to support economic activity.
However, significant headwinds remain, including tight credit conditions and a weak job market.
The balance sheet will also shrink over time as the mortgage-backed securities and other assets we hold mature or are prepaid.
